Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for HBCHRC Foreman Electrical Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Foreman Electrical post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Foreman Electrical post at HBCHRC is scheduled for 08 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they report on this date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Foreman Electrical position?
faq.answer: The required qualification is SSC Plus ITI (Electrical) NCVT/SCVT with 02 years full-time course from a government-recognized institute, along with specific years of experience post-ITI.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Foreman Electrical post is 35 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Foreman Electrical post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Foreman Electrical position is between Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 30,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Foreman Electrical role?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an MCQ Test followed by an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What type of job is this?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview venue?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the HBCHRC office in SAS Nagar, Punjab.

faq.answer: You should carry all original documents and one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.
